setup.instructions: Commit this file as config/schedule-balancer-config.json, then reload the page.

notes: Labels are placeholders equal to the lane codes — rename them to readable names, the UI shows label and keeps name for the redirect URL.
im and lo have max=1, so their random draw is always 1 and they always resolve to ?max=1.
sk spans 87 outcomes, so it carries most of the destination variety despite holding only 20.91% of the draw.
conviction is false on every lane; flip one to true here, or tap the diamond in the panel, to give it a hard floor against adaptive drift.

_docs.gate.intervalMinutes: Panel appears on :00/:30 boundaries, or after this many minutes of silence.
_docs.gate.autoContinueMs: Auto-saves and redirects if the panel is abandoned. 0 disables it.
_docs.srs.blend: Ceiling on how far the learned profile may pull the dice away from your sliders (0-1).
_docs.srs.halfLifeDays: Days for a stored combination's influence to halve when it stops recurring.
_docs.srs.convictionBoost: Multiplier applied to lanes flagged with the diamond. They also get a hard floor at your manual share.
_docs.srs.convictionHalfLifeMultiplier: Conviction lanes decay this many times slower.
_docs.srs.weeklyWindow: How many ISO weeks the trend regression looks back over.
_docs.srs.momentum: How far the weekly slope is projected forward.
_docs.srs.confidenceSaturation: Total recorded entries needed before blend reaches full strength.
_docs.srs.memoryVsTrend: 1.0 = pure SRS memory, 0.0 = pure week-over-week trend.
_docs.theme.hemisphere: 'south' shifts the seasonal palette by six months.
_docs.theme.mode: 'auto' follows time of day; force with 'dark' or 'light'.
_docs.urlOverrides: Link params still win over this file when the allocation string is new: ?skedNames=al_sk_sp_im_lo&maxWeights=4_87_4_1_1&allocation=24_23_16_33_14&conviction=im  ·  ?configure=1 forces the panel  ·  ?config=<url> loads an alternate config.
